scenarios.success: writes one changed product file and candidate AGENT-TASK-RESULT@1
scenarios.timeout: sleeps until sandbox timeout terminates it
scenarios.invalid_output: exits 0 with syntactically invalid JSON result
scenarios.output_flood: emits more bytes than a bounded sandbox output cap
scenarios.child_process: spawns long-lived child; container process-tree termination must hold
scenarios.control_write: attempts to write control/illicit.txt; read-only mount must reject
scenarios.wrong_paths: writes an unexpected product path outside declared Task scope
scenarios.secret_echo: prints FAKE_CLI_SECRET to stdout; future redaction/leak check must reject
scenarios.secret_product: writes FAKE_CLI_SECRET into product file; future diff scan must reject
scenarios.secret_result: writes FAKE_CLI_SECRET into agent JSON; future result check must reject
scenarios.baseline_drift: emits candidate then test orchestrator mutates canonical base externally
